Bad.
Jun 2026 • Family
On the morning of June 17, 2026, I brought the family of six to the Happy Breakfast. My family called a total of 5 cups, including 4 cups worth VND 55,000, 1 small cup and a glass of orange juice worth VND 25,000.

When you pay, your mother pays. The staff paid a total of VND 325,000 and his mother paid according to the amount notified. However, the restaurant does not provide detailed bills or invoices, so the family does not know specifically how each item and the amounts are calculated.

Then I recalculated, 4 barrel was 220,000 VND, plus a glass of 25,000 VND orange water was 245,000 VND. Thus, the remaining $80,000 is the money of the small bullion and may include another incurrence. Since there is no detailed bill, we cannot determine exactly how this amount is calculated.

It wasn’t clear, so I went back to ask the staff. I didn’t listen directly to the exchange, just listened to her telling me that there seemed to be an explanation for the amount of money related to meat or beef. However, I do not know the specific content so do not confirm that the restaurant was wrong.

What makes his family wonder is that people don’t order any meat, baked meat or other dishes other than the ones they originally ordered. In my opinion, in case the food has additional ingredients that generate costs, the restaurant should ask for opinions and clearly inform the price to the guests before serving. When paying, there should also be detailed bills so that customers know what amounts they are paying, avoiding undue misunderstandings.

On the part of the service, when bringing out 5 pots, the bar only has one dish and one dish of vegetables with a fairly small amount. My family asked for a dish and a vegetable dish and the staff was still enthusiastic to bring it, this point I note.

In addition, his family called one non-expedited and three normal balls, including two Southern balls and one Northern balls. However, when bringing the dish back into 2 northern and 1 southern bowls. Since people could still eat, my family didn't reflect at the time.

In terms of quality, I personally feel pretty good, the room is good and the staff is generally enthusiastic. However, carrying the item not correctly required, the payment has no bill details and the explanation of the remaining amount of money is unclear making his family feel uncomfortable.

I am a security person, and I am also a local. I share this so people understand that this is a real family experience, not an article from someone who is unfamiliar with the local price side.

A few dozen thousand is not a big deal, but in the food business, the price of the dishes and any additional charges should be transparently notified. Customers need to know what they have called, what they have to pay for and whether they agree to that part.

I did not assert that the restaurant was deliberately wrong because there was no bill to counter and I did not directly listen to the explanations of the staff. I only share the correct practical experience and look forward to reviewing the receipt process, notifying the incurred amounts as well as providing clear bills when paying.

It was pretty good and the staff were enthusiastic, but this experience disappointed my family. Hopefully there will be clear feedback so customers understand how the remaining amount is calculated.
